name: DUMB
description: Distributed Unlimited Media Bridge is an all-in-one media automation platform for Debrid and Usenet workflows, including service management, onboarding and embedded access to supported Arr, download, mount and media-server applications.

app_vars.name: var_dumb_branch
app_vars.label: DUMB Controller Branch
app_vars.help: Use latest for the current stable release, or enter dev or another I-am-PUID-0/DUMB branch for an advanced test installation; back up persistent state before testing branches

notes.text: DUMB and the services it manages are installed directly in the LXC; this script does not install Docker.
FUSE is enabled for DUMB-managed rclone and filesystem mounts. When all dependent services run inside this LXC, no host mount propagation is required.

If Plex, an Arr app, or another consumer runs outside this LXC, its access to DUMB-created mounts must be configured separately on the Proxmox host. The installer does not expose those mounts automatically.
The first start can take several minutes while DUMB installs and configures the selected service stack. Follow progress with: journalctl -u dumb -f

Run update inside the LXC for a candidate-first DUMB controller update with health verification and automatic rollback. Branch installs continue tracking their selected branch; use DUMB_CONTROLLER_BRANCH=dev update to switch branches or DUMB_CONTROLLER_BRANCH=latest update to return to stable. Update individual managed services through the DUMB Updates interface.

Development branches can change configuration or application state. The controller rollback restores the prior /opt/dumb runtime but does not reverse changes under /config or /data; take an independent backup before switching channels.
